query: SELECT "group".location_id FROM world_member AS member JOIN player_character ON player_character.member_id = member.id JOIN character_group ON character_group.character_id = player_character.character_id JOIN "group" ON "group".id = character_group.group_id WHERE member.id = ? AND member.world_id = ? AND member.user_id = ? AND player_character.character_id = ? AND member.access = 'active'
